title: GTA6 Is So Detailed No Single Employee Knows It All
description: Recent reports highlight the immense scale and detail of GTA6, noting that no single Rockstar employee knows it all—reminiscent of how RDR2's horse physics came to be.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Mind-Boggling Scale and Detail of GTA6

As anticipation for *GTA6* continues to build across the global gaming community, new insights into how Rockstar Games operates shed light on the sheer scale of their upcoming open-world epic. According to a recent report by media outlet Eurogamer, *GTA6* is so incredibly detailed and massive that no single Rockstar employee actually knows everything about it.

This decentralized and hyper-detailed approach to development has long been a hallmark of the studio, offering a window into how some of gaming's most memorable and unexpected features come to life.

## The Origins of Red Dead Redemption 2's Horse Testicles

To understand how Rockstar's development culture fosters such microscopic attention to detail, one only needs to look back at *Red Dead Redemption 2*. The game's infamous animated horse testicles—which realistically shrink in cold weather and expand again in the warmth—have become a symbol of extraordinary, almost absurd dedication to realism.

However, according to Eurogamer, this iconic feature was never part of any mandated list of requirements handed down by management. Instead, it originated entirely from the unexpected, autonomous work of an individual developer or a small group of creators pouring their passion into the cowboy epic.

## Editor's Take

Editor's Take: The freedom given to developers to implement such meticulous, unmandated details is precisely what makes Rockstar's worlds feel so alive. With *GTA6* pushing boundaries even further, players will likely spend years discovering hidden touches that not even the development team remembers adding.
